features.title: Fee-sponsored and sliced conversion before PreStocks deadlines

product_gate.user: XAI holders past the 2026-09-12 deadline, e.g. wallet CtB2LNTp (139.02 XAI, 0 SOL, 0 USDC)
product_gate.buyer: PreStocks token holders; PreStocks (retention of holders through conversion)
product_gate.job: convert expiring pre-IPO tokens before they expire worthless
product_gate.verb: sign one conversion transaction that lands SPACEX in the holder's wallet
product_gate.wedge: sponsor pays fee and rent; large SPACEX to SPCXx conversions split into slices
product_gate.direct_alternative: Jupiter swap or Phantom swap XAI to SPACEX
product_gate.new_capability: 0-SOL wallets can convert (Jupiter Ultra returns Failed to get quotes for XAI to SPACEX); slicing avoids the 9.36% impact of a single 10k SPACEX to SPCXx swap
product_gate.kill_shot: most unconverted value sits in wallets that could pay fees; the fee sponsor serves about 27k of 116k
evidence: 33 of 34 zero-SOL top XAI wallets hold no USDC (getTokenAccountsByOwner, 2026-09-24)
Jupiter quote: SPACEX to SPCXx impact 0.00% at 1k, 9.36% at 10k, 15.49% at 50k
PreStocks X 2026-06-07: tokens expire worthless after conversion deadline
